notes: Michigan publishes the most complete calendar in the Lake Union: a public events category plus the full office calendar (committees, staff worship, treasury meetings). Items in both categories were merged (same title and start date). Internal committee and staff items are kept but marked internal:true, and meetings that repeat 3+ times are listed once with count and dates. Office closures, registration windows, report deadlines and school-calendar days are not counted as events (see skippedNonEvents). Calendar entries have no descriptions, so some categories are inferred from the title (categoryNote). Attendance figures come from conference news reports, where published. Upper Peninsula events run at Camp Sagola; most others at Camp Au Sable (CAS).
